title: Epic: packaged-metadata customization (ADR-0126) — flows first, v17 line
body:
Chartered by maintainer, 2026-08-25, live PM chat, verbatim and untranslated: 「v17 ，然后创建一个epic issue，跟进相关的开发。」 — immediately after ADR-0126 merged and was verified on `origin/main`. Filed by the chartering PM session `session_01KWRU3s15AJz7PGW7a7wdCh`. Standing autonomy ruling, 2026-08-25, verbatim: 「继续自主完成所有开发」 — the program dispatches, drives to green, and enqueues its own PRs; governed surfaces stay human-merge; ADR-0126 §6 wall conflicts stop-and-report.

## What this epic tracks

The implementation program for **ADR-0126** (`docs/adr/0126-packaged-metadata-customization-model.md`, merged `28b47a93`, PR #12063; survey: #12049 [comment 5406807988](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/issues/12049#issuecomment-5406807988)): the platform customization model for packaged metadata — three regimes, one activation ledger. Implementation legs consume the ADR's §§4–7 as settled contract; ⛔ no re-litigation of the model on leg cards — a leg that cannot be built inside the ADR's walls (§6) is a stop-and-report back to the maintainer, not a workaround.

## Release target — maintainer-ruled

**v17 line: ships as a 17.x minor.** Grounds on record: the whole program is additive (an empty `sys_metadata_activation` ledger = packaged default everywhere; no data migration; zero `packages/spec` surface; smooth upgrade for existing installs), the regime's first instance (#11513 permission sets) already shipped inside the v17 line, and the shipped docs promise this work redeems is live on v17 today.
⛔ **Excluded from this epic**: #12057 (paper customization-protocol removal) — deleting exported spec surface is breaking; it rides the next major (v18) on its own enforce-or-remove card per ADR-0126 §6.4.

## Legs — ALL LANDED (L1–L7 + L6-UI: 2026-08-25 · L8: 2026-08-26)

- [x] **L1 — the ledger object** (#12155 · PR #12185 · merged `428f9b24`): `sys_metadata_activation` in `packages/platform-objects` (§4) — `(metadata_type, name, package_id, organization_id nullable-reserved, active)`, uniqueness NULL-collapsed, absence-of-row = active
- [x] **L2 — disable/enable write path** (#12157 · PR #12296 · merged `15249270`, one PR with L3): the flip action writes the durable ledger row; operator-gated (`platform_admin` position) in `group`/`isolated` postures (§5); disable refused while any packaged flow references the target as a subflow (`subflow` AND `map` nodes), refusal names the callers (§7.3)
- [x] **L3 — runtime consult** (#12158 · PR #12296 · merged `15249270`): `execute()`-seam refusal beside `FLOW_DISABLED` reusing its code; install-level row unbinds/rebinds the trigger; a ledger disable survives unregister+re-register (§6 wall 3); the #10243 `flowEnabled` map retired, not shaded (§7.2)
- [x] **L4 — flow clone action** (#12156 · PR #12190 · merged `c68c6708`): new machine name mandatory, whole-definition copy, no recorded ancestry (§7.1; #11703 is the measured counter-example; objectui half follows the #11753 carried-blob discipline)
- [x] **L5 — Setup surface** (objectstack-ai/objectui#6301 · PR objectstack-ai/objectui#6382 · merged `b362c1b`): new "packaged automation" Setup page, shaped on the Setup permission-set page (`nav_permission_sets` contribution precedent); per packaged flow: on/off for this scope + clone, server refusals verbatim — ⛔ no drift/ancestry surface (§7.4, §9)
- [x] **L6 — action disable** (#12160 · PR #12348 · merged `e5ce2ed0`): generalizes the merged L2/L3 machinery to actions (amendment ruling 3, #12049 [comment 5408117664](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/issues/12049#issuecomment-5408117664)) — same ledger, same write authority, consult at action dispatch (`409 ACTION_DISABLED` on both doors, after the capability gate); ⛔ action-clone not chartered
- [x] **L6-UI — packaged actions on/off on the Setup page** (objectstack-ai/objectui#6412 · PR objectstack-ai/objectui#6415 · merged `9602dc82`): completes the #12160 surface-row deliverable — actions section on the L5 page, switch only, ledger read via the object's own sanctioned data API, refusals verbatim; ⛔ no action clone, no drift surface (§9)
- [x] **L7 — docs correction** (#12161 · PR #12368 · merged `e3430a2`): `content/docs/capabilities/integrations.mdx` + `content/docs/build-without-code.mdx` now promise what each regime actually delivers — landed **after** L5 existed, per the §8.4 timing contract
- [x] **L8 — ledger convergence** (#12159 · PR #12419 · merged `af56546a`, maintainer-ruled bundle closing #12159+#12350+#12359): ① `sys_metadata_activation` registration moved to `PlatformObjectsPlugin` under its own manifest carrying the original `scope`/`namespace`/`defaultDatasource` routing verbatim (#12359 option B; double registration measured NOT benign — ADR-0029 D3 throws, so MOVE was the only lawful shape; packaged-action disable now works without the automation service, dogfood-measured on both composition shapes); ② one `metadata_type`-parameterized store in `@objectstack/core` replaces both row-contract copies (#12350) — no API break, both pin suites byte-unchanged and ablation-proven to reach the shared code; ③ permission-set convergence concluded by **ruling A: decline-and-record**, family-wide (permission sets, positions, capabilities keep their own `active` columns; ruling record [#12159 comment 5419767057](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/issues/12159#issuecomment-5419767057)) — no code

## Recorded en route

- Non-packaged `toggleFlow` stays in-process with a loud non-durability warning (option A of the #12296 open question) — deliberately decides nothing; widening the ledger to non-packaged artifacts is a model question for the maintainer if pull appears.
- `DELETE_RESTRICTED` gained its first derivable producer (the §7.3 guard); the error-status baseline was ratcheted down 34→33.
- The ledger's **datasource home** is recorded as an open informational question (PR #12419 preserves today's routing verbatim, deliberately); revisit only on real pull — moving it later means moving the rows too.
- #12349 (in-process `ScopedRepo.execute()` bypass) — still open for triage; ⛔ was never part of the L8 bundle.
- L6-UI observations (recorded in objectui PR #6415, no cards): actions have no `_status`-style read door (the page uses the ledger object's own sanctioned generic read; a future read door would be a drop-in), and a paginated (`hasMore`) ledger read is treated as load failure rather than rendered — a dropped row would show a switched-off action as armed.

## Acceptance testing

- Manual acceptance card for the whole program: **#12438** (17 items, customer-seat, includes the known-boundaries list).

## Relationships

- #11665 (packaged-flow design card, first consumer) — sub-issue of this epic; **closed 2026-08-25**: the §7 flow surface works end-to-end (L1–L5 all merged)
- #12057 — related, **excluded** (v18)
- #11997 (same-name shadow diagnostics) — independent, not gated on this epic
